name: Scary Grocery: The Night Shift [HORROR]
desc:
Congratulations, you've been hired! 🔥
Welcome to your first night shift at The Store. 🏪🌙

The job seems simple:

- Scan customers at the register.
- Check their info on the screen (name, age, job, location).
- Ask questions to verify.

Real customer? Checkout. ✅
Doppelganger? Shoot! 🔫

Toss bodies out 💀, mop up messes, restock shelves, buy items. 

Oh, and one more thing...
Don't let a doppelganger slip through, or face the entity. 😈

Good luck.

Like & join the group! 👍⭐
